name: Drug, pesticide and contaminant screening, with the Witting lab (BGC) method series
basis: 67 systems are one Witting lab series (Dataset - BGC: the same ~850 standards, lipids, bile acids, metabolites and some pesticides, across columns, acetonitrile levels and MS modes); almost all others are screening of pharmaceuticals, drugs of abuse, pesticides and environmental contaminants, plus the METLIN SMRT library of synthetic molecules

name: Plant and food natural products
basis: 21 systems from Data sharing in PredRet for accurate prediction of retention time: application to plant food bioactive compounds (Food Chem 2021); others from plant metabolomes, apple and honey phenolics, natural product dereplication and Chinese herbal medicine; compounds mainly terpenoids, flavonoids, alkaloids and coumarins

name: Endogenous metabolite standards, Folberth et al. 2020 (positive mode)
basis: All from MS2 and LC libraries for untargeted metabolomics (J Chromatogr B 2020, doi:10.1016/j.jchromb.2020.122105): the same standards on 37 methods, positive ionisation

name: Endogenous metabolite standards, Folberth et al. 2020 (negative mode)
Emerging contaminants, Kruve lab (Souihi et al. 2022)
basis: All from MultiConditionRT: predicting liquid chromatography retention time for emerging contaminants for a wide range of eluent conditions (J Chromatogr A 2022, doi:10.1016/j.chroma.2022.462867): one standard mix under 28 eluent conditions

name: Emerging contaminants, retention index set (Aalizadeh et al. 2022)
basis: All from the Thomaidis lab retention index based on the cocamide diethanolamine homologous series (Anal Chem 2022, doi:10.1021/acs.analchem.2c02893): pesticides, pharmaceuticals and other contaminants
